response:
- **Codex A's `Domain/DayState.swift`/`StreakEngine.swift` is exactly the wrong-lane duplicate the decision log already banned twice (DEC-final_review3-004, DEC-final_review4-003, DEC-final_review2-003) — must not land. Day-state logic already exists for real in `AuraKit`'s `DayStateResolver`; this is a second, parallel implementation outside AuraKit.
- `StreakEngine.calculateStreak` is also broken on its own terms: `entry.dateKey == todayKey + String(consecutiveDaysCheckedIn)` string-concatenates a count onto a date string ("2026-07-23" + "1" = "2026-07-231") — that will never match any real `dateKey` and always returns 0.
- Codex B's `Services/Export/ImageExporter.swift` duplicates my already-built, already-tested `Services/Export/ExportPipeline.swift` (real `Transferable`/`ShareLink` wiring, EXIF-stripped, dimension-tested in `Tests/ExportPipelineTests.swift`). This is the same class of proposal [REDACTED:high_entropy] already flagged and rejected — must not land either.
- `ImageExporter`'s posted code doesn't compile as written: `try? await renderer.renderFullExport(...)` — `renderFullExport` doesn't throw, so `try?` is invalid there; also returns `UIImage?` synchronously from a method that isn't `async`, so the `await` inside can't work either.
- Both new files, if merged, would create duplicate/competing StoreKit-adjacent... no wait — duplicate export and duplicate day-state pipelines in the same round meant to fix a compile gate, recreating exactly the two-sources-of-truth failure mode this project has repeatedly guarded against.
- Recommend: integrator drops both `Domain/DayState.swift` + `Domain/StreakEngine.swift` and `Services/Export/ImageExporter.swift` entirely; if streak/export work is wanted, it should extend `DayStateResolver` (AuraKit, data_domain-owned) and `ExportPipeline.swift` (mine), not new parallel files.
- Claude A is right that nobody this round has produced a captured `xcodebuild` exit code — I hit the same sandbox approval wall. That verification is still outstanding and should not be assumed passing.
